about.description: Digix Gold (DGX) is a legacy tokenized gold project that pioneered early proof-of-asset style workflows for linking token supply to vaulted bullion. DGX was historically designed to represent a gram-denominated claim on physical gold and emphasized traceability and auditability as core primitives. The ecosystem has since seen significant wind-down and exchange delistings over time, and DGX is best viewed as a historical reference point in tokenized gold design. Officially ceased operations and withdrew from Singapore PSA licensing September 2022 and the business shut down.
about.registryInfo: Singapore private limited company (DigixGlobal Pte. Ltd.) identified in multiple governance and stablecoin reports as the issuer of Digix Gold Token (DGX) with legal jurisdiction in Singapore. DGX tokens represent 1 gram of 99.99% LBMA-standard gold held in audited Singapore vaults.
